knowledge.applied_rule: Keep shared implementation separate from local authority and mutable data owners. Exact local wrappers preserve existing adapter identities.
Preserve contemporaneous evidence and distinguish procedural integration success from observed business effectiveness. Do not reconstruct past approval chronology.
Use the canonical path, preserve authority and retry limits, and require CI plus exact merged-state verification before completion.

coverage.rationale: Checked merged core SHA and exact script digest, local roadmap hash and unchanged legacy/plan-first selector. New portfolio execution is opt-in and prospective.
Diff is governance/evidence only. Registered lane CURRENT ownership, canonical DB contracts, source rights and frozen numbered research remain unchanged. No data or provider operation executed.

Closeout scope and original implementation chronology are explicit. First recorded integration review does not reset any other package budget. Existing passing CI is reused; evidence commit must earn required CI separately.

rationale: Constructive review inspected actual changed files, policy, roadmap, protocol and frozen authority/QA. They complete the approved architecture without new runtime coupling. No material omitted integration was found within the bounded closeout; merged verification and required CI remain downstream gates.
